project_meta.title: ₹100 रोज़ खर्च करना vs निवेश करना: 5 साल में कितना फर्क पड़ेगा?

global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman explainer animation, warm off-white paper background, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, expressive characters, limited red, green and yellow accent colors, clean visual storytelling, simple readable props, dynamic compositions, consistent character design, vertical 9:16 framing.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, cluttered backgrounds, excessive text, tiny unreadable labels, inconsistent character design, extra limbs, distorted hands, watermarks, logos, overly bright colors.

main_character.label: Stickman Presenter
main_character.visual_dna: A friendly hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black stick arms and legs, and a small red bow tie. Consistent proportions and appearance in every scene.

snack_character.label: Snack Spending Stickman
snack_character.visual_dna: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie, holding snacks and looking excited. Same design as the main presenter.

investing_character.label: Investing Stickman
investing_character.visual_dna: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie, holding a small growing plant and looking confident. Same design as the main presenter.

paper_background.label: Warm Paper Background
paper_background.visual_dna: A clean warm off-white paper background with subtle texture, minimal hand-drawn decorative elements and plenty of empty space.

snack_stall.label: Street Snack Stall
snack_stall.visual_dna: A simple hand-drawn Indian street snack stall with a small counter, samosas, chips packets, tea cups and a handwritten price board. Warm, friendly and uncluttered.

investment_space.label: Investment Growth Space
investment_space.visual_dna: A minimal off-white educational illustration space with a simple rising graph, rupee coins, a growing plant and a few green accent details.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, अगर तुम हर दिन सिर्फ सौ रुपये खर्च करते हो, तो पाँच साल बाद क्या होगा?
beats.prompt_action: A friendly hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie stands close to the viewer, holding up a single 100-rupee note with a curious expression. Warm off-white paper background, bold imperfect black ink outlines, minimal red and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter raises one eyebrow and points toward the 100-rupee note.

beats.narration_text: अब दो रास्ते हैं। पहले रास्ते में वही सौ रुपये रोज़ के स्नैक्स पर खर्च होते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie stands between two large paths. The left path leads toward a colorful Indian snack stall filled with samosas, chips and tea. The right path leads toward a small green growing plant and rupee coins. Warm off-white paper background, clean bold ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter points toward the snack stall first while the two paths remain clearly visible.

beats.narration_text: और दूसरे रास्ते में वही सौ रुपये हर दिन निवेश किए जाते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A clean vertical split-screen illustration. On the left, a hand-drawn stickman with a round white face and red bow tie buys a snack from a small stall. On the right, an identical stickman places a 100-rupee coin into a simple investment jar beside a tiny green plant. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, red and green accents, vertical 9:16 layout.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The left character eats a snack while the right character drops a coin into the investment jar.

beats.narration_text: दोनों के पास शुरुआत में बराबर पैसे हैं। लेकिन पाँच साल बाद नतीजा काफी अलग हो सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin limbs and a red bow tie stands between two large transparent jars, each containing an equal small pile of rupee coins. He looks surprised while pointing toward a calendar marked with five years. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter gestures toward the five-year calendar as the two jars begin to represent different futures.

beats.narration_text: पहले हिसाब समझो। सौ रुपये रोज़ मतलब महीने के लगभग तीन हज़ार रुपये।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie stands at an Indian snack stall, looking at a simple hand-drawn calendar with thirty days circled and a pile of 100-rupee notes beside it. A few samosas and tea cups sit on the counter. Warm off-white background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The stickman counts coins while looking at the calendar.

beats.narration_text: और एक साल में यही रकम हो जाती है छत्तीस हज़ार पाँच सौ रुपये।
beats.prompt_action: A close-up hand-drawn illustration of a calendar showing twelve months beside a growing stack of rupee notes and snack wrappers. A friendly stickman with a round white face and red bow tie points at the stack with a surprised expression. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, limited red accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The money stack grows while snack wrappers pile up beside it.

beats.narration_text: पाँच साल तक ऐसा करने पर तुम्हारे कुल एक लाख बयासी हज़ार पाँच सौ रुपये स्नैक्स में खर्च हो जाएंगे।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie stands beside a huge pile of empty snack packets, samosa plates and tea cups. A five-year calendar and a large stack of rupee notes appear beside him to represent the total money spent. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, clean educational composition, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The snack pile grows dramatically and the stickman looks at it with a shocked expression.

beats.narration_text: और बदले में तुम्हें मिलेंगे स्वादिष्ट स्नैक्स, लेकिन खर्च किए हुए पैसे वापस नहीं आएंगे।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie sits happily eating a samosa, surrounded by empty snack wrappers and an empty wallet. He looks at the empty wallet with a slightly worried expression. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The stickman finishes the snack, checks his wallet and discovers it is empty.

beats.narration_text: अब वही सौ रुपये रोज़ निवेश करने की कल्पना करो।
beats.prompt_action: A friendly hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie carefully places a 100-rupee coin into a transparent investment jar beside a tiny green plant. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, simple green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The stickman drops the coin into the jar and gives the tiny plant a hopeful look.

beats.narration_text: पाँच साल में तुम अपनी जेब से कुल एक लाख बयासी हज़ार पाँच सौ रुपये निवेश करोगे।
beats.prompt_action: A close-up educational illustration showing a hand-drawn stickman's hand placing a 100-rupee coin into an investment jar every day. Beside it, a five-year calendar and a steadily growing pile of rupee coins represent the total contributions. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Coins steadily accumulate inside the jar as calendar pages turn forward.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन यहाँ एक फर्क है। निवेश किए गए पैसे को बढ़ने का मौका मिल सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie watches a green plant grow from a small pot. Rupee coins form the soil around its roots, and a simple upward arrow rises behind it. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The small plant grows taller and the upward arrow extends.

beats.narration_text: मान लो, तुम्हारे निवेश पर औसतन दस प्रतिशत सालाना रिटर्न मिलता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie points at a simple educational board showing a green rising line and a clearly visible ten-percent annual return assumption. A small disclaimer symbol appears near the board. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter taps the ten-percent assumption on the board, emphasizing that it is an example rather than a promise.

beats.narration_text: तो रोज़ निवेश करने पर पाँच साल बाद तुम्हारी रकम लगभग दो लाख सैंतीस हज़ार रुपये हो सकती है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie stands proudly beside a large transparent investment jar filled with rupee coins. A green rising graph and a five-year calendar sit behind the jar. The scene should visually communicate a final value of approximately 2.37 lakh rupees. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The investment jar fills with more coins and the stickman looks pleasantly surprised.

beats.narration_text: यानी तुम्हारे एक लाख बयासी हज़ार पाँच सौ रुपये के निवेश पर लगभग चौवन हज़ार रुपये की बढ़त।
beats.prompt_action: A clean hand-drawn financial comparison on a warm off-white background. Show one stack of rupee coins representing 1,82,500 invested and a separate smaller green stack representing approximately 54,000 growth. A friendly stickman with a round white face and red bow tie points at the extra green coins with an excited expression. Bold black outlines, minimal design, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The green stack of additional coins appears beside the original investment stack.

beats.narration_text: अब दोनों रास्तों को साथ में देखो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie stands between two large side-by-side panels. The left panel shows snack packets and an empty wallet. The right panel shows an investment jar filled with coins and a green growing plant. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, red and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter stretches both arms outward to reveal the two contrasting outcomes.

beats.narration_text: स्नैक्स वाले रास्ते में एक लाख बयासी हज़ार पाँच सौ रुपये खर्च हुए।
beats.prompt_action: The left comparison panel fills the frame. A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face and red bow tie stands beside a mountain of snack wrappers and an empty wallet. A large clear money total of 1,82,500 rupees is shown above the pile. Warm off-white background, bold black ink outlines, red accent details, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The stickman looks at the empty wallet while the snack wrappers remain scattered around him.

beats.narration_text: निवेश वाले रास्ते में वही पैसे बढ़कर लगभग दो लाख सैंतीस हज़ार रुपये हो गए।
beats.prompt_action: The right comparison panel fills the frame. A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face and red bow tie stands beside a transparent jar filled with rupee coins and a healthy green plant. A large clear money total of approximately 2,37,000 rupees appears above it. Warm off-white background, bold black ink outlines, green accent details, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The stickman smiles as the investment jar glows subtly and the plant grows a little taller.

beats.narration_text: दोनों में अपनी जेब से पैसा बराबर गया, लेकिन निवेश वाले रास्ते में लगभग चौवन हज़ार रुपये अतिरिक्त बने।
beats.prompt_action: A clear side-by-side hand-drawn comparison. Left: a stickman surrounded by snack wrappers with an empty wallet. Right: an identical stickman beside an investment jar, a green plant and an extra stack of coins. Add a simple visual arrow pointing to the extra investment growth. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, red and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The extra green coin stack on the investment side becomes more prominent while both sides show equal original contributions.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन एक बात याद रखना, दस प्रतिशत रिटर्न की कोई गारंटी नहीं है। बाज़ार में नुकसान भी हो सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie stands beside a simple investment graph that rises and falls rather than moving in a perfectly straight line. A small caution symbol and a few coins appear nearby. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, muted green and red accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The graph moves through a small dip before rising again, while the presenter raises one finger to signal caution.

beats.narration_text: यह सिर्फ समझाने के लिए एक उदाहरण है। असली नतीजा निवेश के तरीके, रिटर्न और समय पर निर्भर करेगा।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie points at a simple board showing three icons: an investment jar, a fluctuating graph and a five-year calendar. The composition feels like a clear educational explanation, not a sales pitch. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter points to each of the three icons in sequence.

beats.narration_text: इसका मतलब यह नहीं कि तुम्हें स्नैक्स खाना बंद कर देना चाहिए।
beats.prompt_action: A friendly hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie holds a samosa in one hand and a small investment jar in the other. He smiles warmly, showing that enjoying snacks and saving money can coexist. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, balanced red and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter happily takes a small bite of the samosa while keeping the investment jar safe in his other hand.

beats.narration_text: बस हर छोटी खरीदारी से पहले सोचो कि क्या यह पैसा तुम्हारे किसी बड़े लक्ष्य में काम आ सकता है?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie stands at a snack counter, holding a 100-rupee note in one hand. Above him are two thought bubbles: one showing a snack packet, the other showing a growing savings jar. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The stickman pauses before spending and thoughtfully compares the two options.

beats.narration_text: अगर रोज़ सौ रुपये बचाना मुश्किल है, तो छोटी रकम से शुरुआत करो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie drops a few small rupee coins into a savings jar. The jar starts nearly empty, with a tiny green sprout beside it. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, simple green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: A few coins land in the jar and the stickman smiles at the small beginning.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि असली फर्क एक दिन में नहीं, बल्कि रोज़ लिए गए छोटे फैसलों से बनता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a red bow tie walks along a path made of small rupee coins. At the end of the path is a larger savings jar and a healthy green tree. Warm off-white paper background, bold black outlines, green accents, inspiring but simple visual, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The stickman walks forward as the coin path extends and the tree becomes taller.

beats.narration_text: अब बताओ, अगर तुम्हारे पास रोज़ के सौ रुपये हों, तो तुम उन्हें स्नैक्स पर खर्च करोगे या निवेश करोगे?
beats.prompt_action: A friendly hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie faces the viewer directly. He holds a samosa in one hand and a rupee coin above a green investment jar in the other, with a playful questioning expression. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, minimal red and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter alternates pointing toward the samosa and the investment jar, then looks directly at the viewer as if asking for an answer.
